review_evidence: Inventoried all 350 primary Lean files across six unsorry archive packages (0019, 0065, 0066, 0097, 0118 and 0120): exactly 175 goal files and 175 paired library files.

A complete source-shape scan found a theorem/lemma/definition-style declaration in every one of the 350 files. All 175 goal files contain sorry as the proof hole for their mathematical statement, while none of the 175 paired library files contains sorry.

Representative paired files were read directly across the batch; the goals state arithmetic, divisibility and finite-ring problems and the library side supplies corresponding checked Lean developments. No build wrapper, test harness, metadata shim or declaration-free formal file occurs in this unit.
summary: Reviewed this six-package unsorry archive slice; all 350 files are mathematical goal statements or corresponding proved library modules, so the complete unit remains primary-retained.
